positions.name: PipelineSlugGenerationOnMissingId
positions.frame: How should the pipeline resolve and persist artifact identity when an incoming memory lacks an explicit id field?
positions.why: Together, src-1 and src-2 frame the failure-tolerant workflow for identifier resolution: src-1 sets up the absence of a submitted ID, while src-2 details the multi-path slug derivation (LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback) required to successfully commit the artifact.
